messages.subject: segfault with nimArray
parts:
Hi

I'm getting segfaults when trying to assign values to a 3D nimArray. A short reproducible example is attached.

I've the latest CRAN version of Nimble, on R 3.4.4, on Ubuntu. 

Any hints as to what is causing this?

Best
David

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: segfault with nimArray
parts:
hi David,

I simplified your initialization of the array and this should work:

        output <- nimArray(dim=c(nRunParcels, ndays+1, nstates))

Note that nDim shouldn't be needed as the compiler can determine there are three dimensions at compile time. 

That said I didn't look deeply enough to figure out what the error was. I'll file a bug report so one of us can
look more deeply when time permits.

Chris
